notes: Human-authored semantic inventory (issue §2 'Semantic inventory'): behavior the API shape alone cannot express — durable/replay/ordering semantics and documented constraints. Stable IDs are semantic.<slug>. Items here are registered by hand; docs changes emit investigation_required via docs-watch and never auto-edit this file.

items.title: Completed steps replay their recorded result without re-executing the callback
Failed steps retry per retries.limit/delay/backoff before terminal failure
Step and waitForEvent timeouts fail with the documented error shapes
step.sleep/sleepUntil timers persist across process restarts
Events sent while an instance is not waiting are buffered for the next waitForEvent
pause() drains to a pause boundary instead of aborting mid-step
restart({from}) re-executes from the named step with prior history preserved
External side effects in steps are at-least-once: a crash after the effect but before commit may re-run it
Promise.race losers are not re-executed after replay; documented replay limitation for race semantics
Instance retention follows default_retention / per-instance overrides; absent a plan context the default differs from hosted
Subscriptions stream WorkflowInstanceEvent with filters and cursor resume semantics
workflows[].schedules cron entries fire the workflow with schedule metadata
Step inputs/outputs persist through the runtime's serialization contract (structured-clone-compatible values)
Workflow instance operations are also reachable over the hosted Workers REST API surface
Behaviors only observable on hosted Cloudflare (account plan retention, hosted-only error classes) cannot be verified by local oracles
